home.amuni_text:
Welcome, O traveler, to the edge of time,
where history breathes in every wind and chime.
Feel the call of ancient stones, proud and austere,
guardians of tales, of ladies, of prayers sincere.

Do not halt your steps, let this magic hold you nigh,
Amunì, come, I will show you the way.

chat.msg2: Are you ready to be guided? Art, golden olive oil, and sweet almonds will delight you.

citizen.intro_text: The beating heart of Amunì lies in those who live in the village every day. Guardians of ancient stories, handed-down flavors, and secrets hidden among the stones and alleys.
citizen.legends_desc: The most ancient stories of the village, passed down from generation to generation.
citizen.legend_pizzarrone: The Legend of the Pizzarrone Tower
citizen.audio_title: Listen to prayers and tales in dialect
citizen.castle_desc: A millenary fortress: conspiracies, loopholes, secret tunnels, prisons, and epic battles.
citizen.church_desc: A journey through catacombs, traditions, patrons, and ancient devotions.
citizen.church_sangiuseppe: The red gratinata of St. Joseph
citizen.food_desc: Authentic flavors, places to eat and experience the village.

castle.title: Caccamo Castle
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, O travelers, to the mighty keep,
watching over the valley and history deep.
Perched on the mountain of proud living stone,
guardian of dreams and mysteries unknown.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these grand walls that time cannot bend,
dynasties passed like a gust in the wind.
From proud Chiaramonte to Despuches of fame,
each room tells of pacts and a glorious name.
castle.rhyme_3:
Look not for the dates in a cold, dusty page,
but watch the dim shadow that dances with age.
The Castellana awaits you along the old way,
to reveal Sister Felicia's secret today.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to Caccamo Castle, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky outcrop, dominating the valley view.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol pathways tell the story of its defensive role.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble halls were the stages for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve traces of ancient confinements.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel fought for a lady's love.

castello.title: Caccamo Castle
castello.description: Caccamo Castle is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that recall centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.
castello.tickets: Full price € 6.00 | Reduced € 4.50 (Exclusively with online booking)

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor made entirely of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular services, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full price € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the borough. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed John Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred works of art that witness centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to St. George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece dominating the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from sculptures of the Gaginian school to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visits Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Set in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of profound spirituality felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and worshipers alike.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sundays and Holidays visits in the slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the conventual structure, the area offers an authentic glimpse into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time opening hours of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small masterpieces scattered around.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and of grace,
open their doors to time's ancient embrace.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in a silence so deep,
the Blessed John, whom the town’s memories keep.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If down to the Badia your footsteps shall lead,
a garden of grand majolica blooms at your feet.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Step into the Duomo, majestic and grand,
where Stom and Gagini shake art's timeless hand.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
The Annunziata then opens its painted domes wide,
near the ancient watchtower where guards used to hide.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Then climb to Cappuccini, where high hills arise,
between a rare Altarpiece and panoramic skies.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stood still...
